About Xila

On this page

WASM runtime ​

The xila-wasm Cargo package implements the Wasmi runtime and guest helper APIs. The native and browser examples mount its executable at /applications/executables/wasm. Sources: executables/wasm/Cargo.toml and executables/wasm/src/host/main.rs.

Command syntax ​

text
/applications/executables/wasm [--install] [--stack-size <bytes>] [--instruction-limit <fuel>] <path>

The command runs in Xila's terminal. <path> must identify a regular guest file in the VFS; the loader reads the supplied path directly and does not perform Current_directory resolution. The guest receives its module path as its argument and the task environment as its environment.

Argument/optionDefaultBehavior
<path>RequiredGuest module file path. Use an absolute VFS path.
--installOffSelects __install: () -> () instead of _start: () -> (). A missing or incorrectly typed export fails.
--stack-size4096Parsed as a stack size, but currently not applied by the runtime.
--instruction-limit100,000Nonzero fuel quantum used by resumable execution. Fuel is replenished after yielding; this is not a total instruction limit.

Cargo features ​

FeaturePurpose
hostWasmi interpreter and Xila executable integration; includes browser-hosted Xila.
guestGuest helpers without the interpreter when default features are disabled.
graphicsGenerated graphics wrappers and supported host imports.
c_bindingsGuest C wrappers/header generation; enables guest/graphics dependencies.
memory_3232-bit guest-word translation configuration; default.
memory_64Alternate 64-bit guest-word translation configuration; bundled applications remain wasm32.
default_guestguest,graphics,c_bindings,memory_32; emits xila_graphics.h in the build output directory.

Default features are host,memory_32. Guest-only consumers must disable defaults. Core's xila package has neither a host nor a wasm feature; these runtime features belong to the xila-wasm package.

Results and errors ​

  • WASI proc_exit(0) succeeds; a nonzero exit code becomes a runtime error.
  • Argument, file-kind, compilation, instantiation, missing-export, and execution failures are reported on stderr and return a nonzero executable result.
  • Standard streams are descriptors 0/1/2 in the per-execution WASI context. The root directory is preopened if available.
  • Graphics status and capability errors are defined in the graphics reference.

Execution limits ​

CapabilityCurrent constraint
InterpreterWasmi 2 with validation, memory64 support, and automatic portable/native dispatch as available.
TranslationFunctions are translated eagerly before execution so fuel exhaustion cannot suspend lazy callee translation. This can increase startup work.
SchedulingFuel exhaustion and sched_yield yield cooperatively to the executor. Wasmi 2 meters input Wasm operators, so slice timing is not version-stable.
poll_oneoffUp to 64 supported realtime/monotonic subscriptions. Invalid UTC does not prevent monotonic polling; file-descriptor readiness remains unsupported.
Startup clockUses the monotonic Embassy source; adjustable UTC is separate and can be unsynchronized.
WebAssembly start sectionsSuspension is unsupported. WASI command guests should use exported _start.
WASI/graphics compatibilityPartial WASI coverage and a supported graphics subset, not full compatibility.
Graphics ABIGuest and host must match the LVGL revision/configuration; only registry-supported wrappers are generated, with no capability negotiation yet.

Browser capabilities ​

AreaBrowser example behavior
Host targetXila builds for wasm32-unknown-unknown; application guests build for wasm32-wasip1.
Storage APIsRequires OPFS, FileSystemFileHandle.createWritable, and Web Locks on localhost/HTTPS.
Disk formatThe selected disk is a 16 MiB MBR/LittleFS image local to the browser origin.
Disk namesxila_drive.img remains the legacy/default image. New disks use xila_YYYY-MM-DD.img with numeric collision suffixes.
Disk managementThe Xila Help panel lists, creates, selects, and removes managed images. The selected image is remembered for the origin.
Disk ownershipOne Xila tab can hold a given disk's lifetime Web Lock. Different tabs may use different disks.
Disk switchingNew writes stop, pending changes are saved, the current lock is released, and the page reloads on the selected image. An image open elsewhere cannot be removed.
SavesAt boot, every second when dirty, and on normal shutdown; synchronous flushes update the memory cache.
Memory16 MiB selected-disk cache plus one temporary 16 MiB snapshot and browser buffering during saves. Guest/interpreter/graphics and embedded application bytes add further costs.
Fresh accountadministrator with an empty password; created only for a fresh disk. Existing accounts are restored.
Bundled guestsCalculator, Clock, Pixel Painter, Synth, Weather, and Text Editor are included in new locale-matched seeded images under /applications/executables; matching release guest artifacts are needed for image creation. Existing persistent disks are not upgraded automatically.
Guest uploadNo general upload mechanism. Other guests must already be present in the VFS.
NetworkingNo Xila network manager; HTTP uses Fetch under CORS/browser restrictions and does not expose raw sockets.

Browser-managed storage can be evicted or lost; abrupt termination can lose changes since the last completed save. See Browser storage for the durability model and Manage browser disks for user-facing disk operations.
